t.task_id, t.task_no, t.title, t.description, t.parent_id, t.project_id, p.name as project_name, p.status as project_status, p.owner_id as project_owner_id, t.assignee_id, ifnull(nullif(ua.nick_name, ''), ua.user_name) as assignee_name, da.dept_name as assignee_dept_name, t.creator_id, ifnull(nullif(uc.nick_name, ''), uc.user_name) as creator_name, t.auditor_id, ifnull(nullif(ud.nick_name, ''), ud.user_name) as auditor_name, t.priority, t.tags, t.status, t.due_time, t.start_time, t.submit_time, t.finish_time, t.reject_count, t.overdue_flag, t.source, t.recur_id, t.dept_id

from oa_task t left join oa_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id left join sys_user ua on ua.user_id = t.assignee_id left join sys_dept da on da.dept_id = ua.dept_id left join sys_user uc on uc.user_id = t.creator_id left join sys_user ud on ud.user_id = t.auditor_id

sql.if: and (t.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.task_no like concat(#{keyword}, '%'))
and t.status in ('0', '1') and t.due_time < sysdate()

mapper.sql: order by (case when t.status in ('0', '1') and t.due_time < sysdate() then 1 else 0 end) desc, t.priority asc, t.due_time asc, t.task_id desc
mapper.select: select from oa_task t where t.task_id = #{taskId}
select from oa_task t where t.task_id = #{taskId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into oa_task ( task_no, title, description, project_id, parent_id, assignee_id, priority, tags, status, start_time, due_time, finish_time, submit_time, reject_count, creator_id, auditor_id, source, recur_id, generate_date, overdue_flag, dept_id, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{taskNo}, #{title}, ifnull(#{description}, ''), #{projectId}, #{parentId}, #{assigneeId}, ifnull(#{priority}, '1'), ifnull(#{tags}, ''), ifnull(#{status}, '0'), #{startTime}, #{dueTime}, #{finishTime}, #{submitTime}, ifnull(#{rejectCount}, 0), #{creatorId}, #{auditorId}, ifnull(#{source}, '0'), #{recurId}, #{generateDate}, ifnull(#{overdueFlag}, '0'), #{deptId}, ifnull(#{createBy}, ''), sysdate() )

insert into oa_task ( task_no, title, description, project_id, parent_id, assignee_id, priority, tags, status, start_time, due_time, finish_time, submit_time, reject_count, creator_id, auditor_id, source, recur_id, generate_date, overdue_flag, dept_id, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{taskNo}, #{title}, ifnull(#{description}, ''), #{projectId}, #{parentId}, #{assigneeId}, ifnull(#{priority}, '1'), ifnull(#{tags}, ''), ifnull(#{status}, '0'), #{startTime}, #{dueTime}, #{finishTime}, #{submitTime}, ifnull(#{rejectCount}, 0), #{creatorId}, #{auditorId}, ifnull(#{source}, '1'), #{recurId}, #{generateDate}, ifnull(#{overdueFlag}, '0'), #{deptId}, ifnull(#{createBy}, 'system'), sysdate() ) on duplicate key update update_time = update_time
mapper.update: update oa_task set status = '1', start_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '0'
update oa_task set status = '2', submit_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '1'
update oa_task set status = '3', finish_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '2'
update oa_task set status = '1', reject_count = reject_count + 1, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '2'
update oa_task set status = '4', update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('0', '1')
mapper.select: select from oa_task t where t.parent_id = #{parentId} order by t.task_id asc
select count(*) from oa_task where parent_id = #{parentId} and status <> '3'
select from oa_task t where t.parent_id = #{parentId} and t.status <> '3' order by t.task_id asc
select from oa_task t where t.assignee_id = #{userId} and t.status in ('0', '1') order by t.task_id asc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: update oa_task set status = '4', update_time = sysdate() where assignee_id = #{userId} and status in ('0', '1')

update oa_task set overdue_flag = case when status in ('0', '1') and due_time < sysdate() then '1' else '0' end, update_time = sysdate() where overdue_flag <> case when status in ('0', '1') and due_time < sysdate() then '1' else '0' end
mapper.select: select from oa_task t where t.source = '1' and t.status in ('0', '1') and t.generate_date is not null and date_format(t.generate_date, '%Y%m%d') = #{generateDate} order by t.task_id asc
select max(cast(substring(task_no, 10) as signed)) from oa_task where task_no like concat('T', #{datePart}, '%')

select from oa_task t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.assignee_id left join oa_member m on m.user_id = t.assignee_id and m.del_flag = '0' where t.status in ('0', '1') and (u.user_id is null or u.status = '1' or u.del_flag = '2' or m.status in ('1', '2')) order by t.task_id asc
select from oa_task t where t.auditor_id = #{auditorId} order by t.task_id asc

select
and
and (p.status = '0' or t.project_id is null)
and t.status in ('0', '1') and t.due_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
and t.status in ('0', '1') and t.due_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day) and t.due_time < date_add(date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day), interval 7 day)
and t.creator_id = #{params.me}
and t.status <> '4'

select coalesce(sum(case when t.status in ('0', '1') and t.due_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as today, coalesce(sum(case when t.status in ('0', '1') and t.due_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day) and t.due_time < date_add(date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day), interval 7 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as week, coalesce(sum(case when t.status in ('0', '1') and t.due_time < sysdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as overdue, coalesce(sum(case when t.status = '2' and (t.auditor_id = #{me} or t.creator_id = #{me}) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as toAudit, coalesce(sum(case when t.creator_id = #{me} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as created, count(*) as total from oa_task t left join oa_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id where (t.assignee_id = #{me} or t.creator_id = #{me} or t.auditor_id = #{me} or exists (select 1 from oa_task_collaborator c where c.task_id = t.task_id and c.user_id = #{me})) and (p.status = '0' or t.project_id is null)
